# 2014 Elections

There were 5 elections held in Jersey in 2014.

- **[St Helier No 1 Deputy By-Election](https://flow.je/elections/2014#e18)**

  1 seat · 5 candidates · 15.2% turnout
- **[St Helier No 2 Deputy By-Election](https://flow.je/elections/2014#e44)**

  1 seat · 4 candidates · 14% turnout
- **[Senators General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2014#e19)**

  8 seats · 18 candidates · 39.8% turnout
- **[Deputies General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2014#e20)**

  29 seats (6 uncontested) · 55 candidates · 38.9% average turnout
- **[Connétables General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2014#e21)**

  12 seats (11 uncontested) · 13 candidates · 54.3% turnout

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

[**View a sentiment analysis of the manifestos**](https://flow.je/elections/2014/analysis)

## 2014 St Helier No 1 Deputy By-Election

Following the loss of a libel action regarding a satirical cartoon, [Trevor Pitman](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/trevor-pitman) and [Shona Pitman](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/shona-pitman) were disqualified from the States in January 2014 after being declared bankrupt (1 seat), 5th March 2014.

**[Nick Le Cornu](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/nick-le-cornu) was elected as Deputy of St Helier No 1 in 2014**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Nick Le Cornu](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/nick-le-cornu)** |  | 248 | 33.2% |
| 2 | [Gordon Forrest](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gordon-forrest) |  | 201 | 26.9% |
| 3 | [Paul Le Claire](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/paul-le-claire) |  | 178 | 23.8% |
| 4 | [Roy Travert](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/roy-travert) |  | 70 | 9.4% |
| 5 | [Maureen Morgan](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/maureen-morgan) |  | 51 | 6.8% |

748 votes

4,915 registered voters

15.2% turnout
